subject: Graduate Engineer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hi Alice,

I've lodged my application for the Cadet/Graduate Engineer role in the Civil Design team through the Council website, and wanted to say hello directly since the ad lists you as the contact.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries as part of the design work. My civil engineering degree (Philippines, 2019) covered surveying and hydraulics, and I worked on site there for about a year doing inspections, drawing reviews and site records.

I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

If it would help to see my drawings before shortlisting, they're at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to answer any questions.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

Hello,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK, with my resume and cover letter attached as the ad asks.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 and draft in AutoCAD in 2D and 3D. In the diploma I prepared and reviewed drawings to Australian Standards, which is the part of this role I'd be strongest in from day one. I haven't used Pryda software yet, so I would need to learn it, and I'd put the hours in.

I have about a year of site experience in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020, reading architectural and structural drawings, checking work against them, dealing with suppliers and keeping clients updated on progress. Customer contact wouldn't be new to me.

I live in Melton and have my own transport, so Somerton is a commute I can do. I hold a White Card and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
